description: Major has invented one of his useful contraptions, but no-one is allowed to touch it while he is away. It's a shame that Beag didn't listen to him.

description: Tha seillean glacte ann an uamhag Bhernie - an tig aig Oona 's Baba air a shàbhaladh? There's a bee trapped in Bernie's grotto - will Oona and Baba be able to save him.

title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
description: Tha Otto feumach air cuideachadh bho charaidean 's gun sgeul aige air Pip neo Pop! Otto needs help from his friends as he tries to locate a missing Pip and Pop.

title: Bing
description: Tha Bing is a charaidean a' tarraing dhealbhan-duilleig an-diugh. Bing and his friends are making leaf pictures today.

title: Bing
description: Tha einnsean-smàlaidh sa phàirc agus tha a h-uile duine airson suidhe na bhroinn. There is a fire engine in the park and everybody wants to get a chance to sit inside it.

title: Peicein/Petit
description: Petit and Laura argue about who should be the one that makes the rules of Greg and Roman's game.

title: Hilda
description: Tha Hilda is a caraidean a' sireadh phlanntraisean annasach. Hilda and her friends are searching for rare plants. Folllowed by Geamaichean Gorach.

title: Geamaichean Gorach
description: Uair an dèidh uair, tha Coinneach Clogaid na rògaire! Time after time, Coinneach Clogaid behaves like a rogue.

title: Geamaichean Gorach
description: Tha tòrr rudan blasta mu ar coinneamh - ach Coinneach Clogaid a-mhàin! There are many tasteful things to behold - except for Coinneach Clogaid, of course.

title: Flix
description: Tha dùbhlan aig Flix is Burma - tha aca ri bhith càirdeil ri chèile. Flix and Burma have a challenge, they must be friendly with one another.

title: A-null 's a-nall
description: Ged nach eil e àbhaisteach 'son nighean Ròma, tha Lena airson a bhith na ballerina. Although not usual for a Roma girl, Lena wishes to be a ballerina.
